outline.scope: Exact Project 4 extract; source DOCX digest supplied by document owner

reference_scope: Measured and reference compute use the same effective work F and participating chip count k within each efficiency calculation. The calibrated reference is not a proven theoretical upper bound or vendor peak.

requirements.timing: Matched-workload uninstrumented synchronized wall clock including transfer, communication and synchronization; no estimated subtraction of instrumentation overhead.
requirements.reference: Independent calibration, necessary workload, actual stage dependencies, resource overlap and necessary scheduling; exclude redundant work and extra implementation waiting.
forbidden_reference_substitutes: reverse fitting to measured B0 or B1 time
requirements.comparison: Same reference method; separately derive reference time when precision, workload or execution path differs. Efficiency ratios under different references are not performance gains.
requirements.timing_refinement: Same-run basic-operation F and synchronized T retain all native statistics and host-counting costs. Official B0/B1 own F/T/C pairing is closed. Prior operator-DAG eta remains attached to its own method. New whole-chain reference and acceptance remain unresolved. Not strictly uninstrumented.

limitations: All three schedule scenarios are reported. Their range is sensitivity, not a confidence interval or bound over all schedules.
